blind.description: A stylized fantasy balance scale statue or idol crafted in bronze and dark green enameled metal. It features a faceted hexagonal base leading into a segmented cylindrical pillar, capped with a diamond finial. A curved bronze crossbeam with emerald accents supports two suspended shallow bronze scale pans hung by rigid triangular struts. All surfaces are clean, smooth, solid, and fully textured in a hand-painted game art style.
blind.from_above: An elongated symmetrical silhouette showing the central pyramidal cap, a narrow horizontal beam extending outward to two circular bronze bowls, resting above a hexagonal green and gold base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the figure (around 3.5 to 4 feet tall), with a pan-to-pan width of roughly 2.5 to 3 feet.

notes: Base pedestal features a segmented cylindrical pillar rather than distinct stacked coins, but reads cleanly as an idol at table distance
footprint proportion 1.52x off the catalog (5.7 x 3.1 ft)
